::: {.callout-warning}
This is a retained parameter-estimation study. Its internal pressure-level
holdout is not independent validation of the reactive MEA model.
:::

# Question

Can a neutral MEA–water binary-VLE fit distinguish the 2B, 3B and 4C
association topologies and provide a defensible value of
$k_{\mathrm{MEA,H_2O}}$ for the later reactive calculations?

# Starting point and strategy

The study started from the source-based pure-component parameters and the
numerical interaction value $k_{\mathrm{MEA,H_2O}}=-0.052$. Cai et al. (1996),
Tables 2–3, supplied 25 non-endpoint rows: 13 at 66.66 kPa and 12 at
101.33 kPa, spanning 362.81–431.85 K. Four pure endpoints were excluded and
no reactive observations entered this fit.

The three association topologies were compared by leaving one pressure level
out at a time. Each row used a boiling-temperature residual scaled by 1 K and
a vapor-water mole-fraction residual scaled by 0.01. The bounded one-coordinate
iteration used exact Engine sensitivities and at most 12 iterations. The
pressure-grouped one-standard-error rule selected 2B; the selected topology was
then refit to all 25 rows.

# Numerical result

::: {.parameter-table .numeric-table}
| 2B fit | Fitted $k_{ij}$ | Training scaled RMSE | Held-pressure mean squared scaled residual |
|:--|--:|--:|--:|
| Train 101.33 kPa; hold 66.66 kPa | −0.06325729 | 1.08622 | 11.05763 |
| Train 66.66 kPa; hold 101.33 kPa | −0.08221555 | 2.06247 | 7.36788 |
| Refit all 25 rows | **−0.07352750** | 2.09643 | — |
:::

The grouped mean score was 9.2128 with standard error 1.8449, compared with
102.7293 for 3B. The 4C run failed its phase, bounds or uncertainty gates
before a complete score could be assigned. The conditional local-linearized
95% interval for the 2B value is [−0.07791917, −0.06913583], with standard
error 0.00224065 and 49 residual degrees of freedom.

# Conclusion and limits

The study supports 2B over the tested alternatives for the Cai binary-VLE
range and records a conditional value for the MEA–water interaction. It does
not show that the value is transferable to reactive electrolyte states, that
the pure-component parameters were independently fitted here, or that the
interval is a full uncertainty statement. Twelve observations exceeded the
original 393.15 K packet limit and were evaluated only under an explicitly
extended domain.

The value is therefore a documented neutral starting point for the bundle,
not a stand-alone qualification of the full nine-species model.
